2. 13 rajab ki bazm sajai

<<DIVIDER>>

3. Tune namaz e ishq sikhai

<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>
padhne laga wo tera qaseeda
jab bhi kabhi qur'aan ko khola
<<DIVIDER>>
banao jashn ke kaabe mein aa rahe hai ali
khuda ke ghar se buto'n ko bhaga rahe hai ali
<<DIVIDER>>
jidare kaaba ne has kar kaha khuda ki qasam
mujhe tawaaf ke qabil bana rahe hai ali
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Joothi khudao'n walo aao

<<DIVIDER>>
